We highly recommend A Oasis! They’ve been absolutely fantastic to work with. We started our pool and spa installation plans back in August of 2020 with Jamie Fletcher. We ended up hitting pause due to the pandemic. After two years, we decided to restart this project. We found our communication email thread with Jamie from over two years ago!  She promptly responded and got us on the books to review our plans right away. It was as if we had talked on the phone yesterday. Jamie was such a pleasure to work with. To put it lightly, we are a little OCD and very involved when it comes to home improvement projects. Jamie was a saint and effortlessly walked us through no less than 7 revisions of our original plans! Thank you Jamie!

As we progressed through our plans at light speed in less than a month, we finally had the pleasure of meeting Jake Davis, our project manager. Despite having a backlog of other projects- we broke ground one month and one week after placing our deposit. This is incredible because Jake and Jamie were aware that we had travel plans coming up at the end of the year, and we would ultimately have to hit pause on the project once we were out of town. Jake did a fantastic planning the project around our schedule needs. Jake quickly discovered how involved we would be in this project and was always timely and responsive. Jake respected our wishes and included us every step of the way. As previously mentioned, and due the level of involvement we require, we would say Jake was extraordinary as most folks going through a pool installation probably wouldn’t have this level of communication with their project manager.
While respecting our budget, Jake was fantastic in making recommendations to enhance our pool and spa build.
All in all, what can usually be a stressful project, Jake’s ability to accommodate and shift gears when needed gave us complete peace of mind throughout the duration of the project. The entire A Oasis team has an been wonderful to work with.
While there are certainly other options when it comes to pool installation, A Oasis has proven their quality and value and worth every penny.

Thank you Jamie, Jake, and the entire A Oasis crew for making our pool dreams a reality!

reviews.text: We chose A Oasis because the design process was low pressure, the designer listened to our needs and helped us create something within our budget and our wants. Our concrete around our pool was horrendous and had to be refinished. Our coping tile was cut incorrect, wrong tile ordered and had to be fully replaced. Our landscaping was done lazily and had to be redone, sod had to be redone multiple times. reviews.text:
This review is for the sales side of the business. A separate review has been posted for the construction side.

That being said, everyone we met and spent time with at A-Oasis was friendly and made us feel comfortable with such a big project.

Pros: Friendly staff, comfortable office environment, ability to meet everyone in the office and stop in anytime needed when questions arise.

As far as why we gave a 3 out of 5 stars is due to lack of communication from our sales person Dominic, and two errors made on our contract that cost us a loss in labor costs in the end. At the start of the process, we felt taken care of by our sales person. However, once we put our deposit down, he was impossible to reach. After weeks of calls, texts and emails, I tracked him down at the office and asked why he hadn’t been responding. Tim stepped in and took over most of the communication at that point and he was very helpful. Before construction, I noticed that our plan didn’t have saltwater checked. When I pointed this out, it became apparent if I hadn’t found that error, they would have moved forward with a chlorine pool and not saltwater. That’s a significant error. The other oversight by our sales person was that he didn’t check the box for sod on our contract. Our pool was finished and we were left with a dirt yard after construction. We specifically confirmed that we wanted the yard to be reset as it was with sod after construction, but our project manager Phillip sent us the order where that particular box had not been checked. After getting a separate quote for sod, the labor alone was $3k. It should have been done within the pool project, so now we are replacing the sod ourselves in order to save on that extraneous labor cost.

If you do choose to go with A-Oasis, be very mindful of who they assign to you. Get recommendations first for a specific person.

reviews.text: I've waited a year to post my review. reviews.text:
This is a difficult review to write because in the end we got most of what we ordered, but it was incredibly painful to get there and the experience was very disappointing over many, many months of serious issues in mismanaging our project. Aoasis came highly recommended and reviewed, and our initial consultation was positive - fun even. However, when we got into the work there was problem after problem. First, our masonry was not ordered on time and we were forced to use another product we did not choose (and for which no cost difference was received or credited) even then what we got was wrong (had to literally rip it out) and then it was not installed correctly in many places. Then the landscaping was not done correctly (giant pile of dirt for plants instead of digging a hole...) then the salted concrete was absolutely done incorrectly and was left stained and cracked immediately to the point that the contractor had to resurface at great expense. I'm very concerned the concrete as a whole was defectively installed - time will tell and the photos, emails and documentation may some day end up in arbitration. Then, they killed a huge part of the yard that was not necessary despite our rapid communication about their laydown process, and again had to battle to get that grass replaced because it was not estimated correctly. In fairness, they did replace the grass but with a product that is not the same as the rest of the yard. Then, the coping tile was damaged, rough cut and just very poor quality. Then, the pipes that were just laid burst under pressure testing. Then, the builders did not properly reinforce the wood cabana structure and it almost blew over... Then, the electrical was not installed in the correct location. Only THEN, our project manager was finally fired after months of poor work and zero quality control (which was communicated to the ownership many times before this) , which led to months more re-work. I get that happens in construction, but when brought to the attention of the owner, managers and leads, absolutely no one came to our rescue for months in an adequate way. To this day, the owner Charlie has not responded to any of our dozens of messages, emails and calls. Not one thank you for your business, not one sorry for the issues you experienced. Not one, we failed you and here's why it happened. There was no communication at any step of the way in the way that you deserve when spending six figures on a dream back yard. There were promises to help, eventually, and someone finally did connect with us for direct responses and fixed most issues. But even that has reverted back to minimal communication, no planning and no urgency. It was SO painful and stressful and took 3-4 times longer than promised to deliver this work - and truthfully it is not 100% right but it's what I'm going to get at this point. My biggest issue here is that this company promised a lot, and did not deliver against very basic expectations or timeliness and communication. I would, unfortunately, never wish this process on my enemy. It's not good business, not acceptable to treat customers like a rotating door of cash payments, and not OK not to communicate.  Please be cautious if selecting this company, and I hope my experience is isolated - but I will warn you that the way upper management handled our project is very telling of their overall business process. All I really wanted was for them to be responsive, honest, timely and appreciate my business. I didn't really get any of that.  If they respond to this review, it would honestly be more responsive than we have received in the last six months.

Update: I increased to two stars to be fair. We do have a pool and cabana. But I’m still deeply disappointed in how this all went down.

reviews.text: I would like to give a shout  to Chris for being so helpful, even almost a year after our pool has been completed, they are there to help. It seems that the values on our pool equipment had been knocked out of their proper positions and my husband took pictures and sent them to Chris and he quickly responded and helped us out. A Oasis made our pool build seamless and are still very helpful. Thx Again!
reviews.author: Vicki Beighey

reviews.text: Charley worked closely with my wife and I to make sure we were fully comfortable and informed on our new back yard oasis. Charley has great recommendations and pool design ideas. We were both very comfortable with AOasis through the entire process of building our pool. AOasis was able to also install additional concrete I needed very timely and also 500’ of fence I sprung on them at the last minute. I would certainly recommend AOasis to build another pool for me. My pool has been completed for over 2 years with not one single issue.
reviews.author: Matt Keever

reviews.text: Loved working with Sarah H to build the design for our pool. It’s so nice that they have an office in Midlothian to see selections and talk through the plans. Looking forward to soaking it up in our pool next year!
reviews.author: Ashley Morales

reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience from start to finish.  Dominic was responsive, professional, and always there to answer any questions I had.  He went above and beyond to guarantee us a wonderful experience.  The owner, Charley, came to check on the job many times throughout the process.  I will be recommending A Oasis to all my friends and family.
reviews.author: Kelli Wyatt

reviews.text: Charley and his crew were awesome to work with! I had them not only construct a brand new pool but also completely redo a very large retaining wall! It’s all beautiful! I wanted something unique and he was willing to work with all my different ideas. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Kathy Goen

reviews.text: Charlie and his team extended our patio in 2016,  built a fireplace, added wood lattice and greenery for privacy. They were punctual, professional and courteous. Charlie followed my husband's design and recommended the greenery to use. We have thoroughly enjoyed our "oasis" and I recommend A Oasis Pools & Outdoor Living for all your patio/outdoor needs.
reviews.author: Crystal Pennington

reviews.text: I absolutely had the best customer service experience with this company! I really enjoyed talking to Sandy Duncan. She was so nice, responsive, and punctual when it came to returning my phone calls about my questions. She gave me estimates over the phone and even was able to schedule a home visit in the same week! Before finding this company I had called maybe 13 other companies and had really negative experiences. This is the only company where my experience was completely positive. When you call ask for Sandy Duncan because she was incredibly helpful!
reviews.author: Alina

reviews.text: The sales team was great, the design was beautiful, but that's where the good stops. The project managers don't communicate effectively and don't follow through. We are one month out from our final walk through, and the things needing to be done are still sitting here unfinished.
reviews.author: Amanda Garcia

reviews.text: From dig day to swimming 34 days!!! We were so very pleased with A Oasis!! I have told everyone we know to use them.  Everything was great and we had our pool just in time for summer to start this year!
reviews.author: Amariss Feemster

reviews.text: I got a pool done by Aoasis and Charley is the best.  He did exactly what I wanted and we are obsessed with the pool.  We got a rectangular shaped pool with a pergola and and some landscaping.  It was fantastic.  He also added a firepit with a waterfall.  The experience was fantastic, he was on time, always had is crew working, everyone was respectful and answered any questions and phone calls.  I highly recommend him.  Anyone that asks about a pool, I recommend Aoasis.  Everyone that sees our pool talks about how he created an outdoor living space for summer or winter.  He is fantastic.
reviews.author: Bo Moore

reviews.text: Our pool was recently completed and my husband and I couldn't be more pleased.  Our first encounter was with Bryton who put our dream together on paper.  Once construction began, Jake communicated with us on a daily basis via the BuilderTrend app and via text when needed.  End result is a beautiful addition to our yard.  Thanks guys ... Donna
reviews.author: Donna Garza

reviews.text: We want to shout out to Jamey Barron, as he has done a great job helping us through the process of building our dream pool and a beautiful pergola.  Jamey is very knowledgeable and understands what we need, which was helpful.  Thank you again for the experience!
reviews.author: OnDaRealz

reviews.text: A Oasis did our pool, deck, turf, and landscaping.   Top notch on all.  Professional and willing to go above and beyond.   Especially Jean and her team.  Also Phillip G. and his team.  Thanks so much
reviews.author: Chris Davis
